verdict.rationale: The pack describes a single logo-design skill, installed via one marketplace plugin, by copying the skill folder, or by uploading a full or lite zip. There is no evidence of a multi-skill collection that lets a developer pick individual skills. The lite zip is a smaller variant of the same skill, not selective installation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install only the specific skills I want from a collection instead of taking the whole bundle
